extends "res://scripts/screen.gd"
## FUN BLAST: WarioWare-style marathon of micro-games against the Boredom Blob.

const MICROS := {
	"pop": preload("res://scripts/micro/pop.gd"),
	"boop": preload("res://scripts/micro/boop.gd"),
	"catch": preload("res://scripts/micro/catch.gd"),
	"dodge": preload("res://scripts/micro/dodge.gd"),
	"feed": preload("res://scripts/micro/feed.gd"),
	"pump": preload("res://scripts/micro/pump.gd"),
	"stop": preload("res://scripts/micro/stop.gd"),
	"count": preload("res://scripts/micro/count.gd"),
	"odd": preload("res://scripts/micro/odd.gd"),
	"slice": preload("res://scripts/micro/slice.gd"),
	"jump": preload("res://scripts/micro/jump.gd"),
	"whack": preload("res://scripts/micro/whack.gd"),
	"donttouch": preload("res://scripts/micro/donttouch.gd"),
	"keepup": preload("res://scripts/micro/keepup.gd"),
	"launch": preload("res://scripts/micro/launch.gd"),
	"splat": preload("res://scripts/micro/splat.gd"),
}
const BOSS := preload("res://scripts/micro/tickle.gd")
const BOSS_EVERY := 12
const BUDDY_COLS := [Color("ff3d7f"), Color("ffd23f"), Color("2ec4ff"), Color("7cf05a")]
const WIN_LINES := ["NOOO! Too much fun!", "Stop having FUN!", "Ugh! Colors!", "My boring plan!", "No fair!", "You're too fast!"]
const LOSE_LINES := ["Yaaawn... boring!", "Hehe, so dull...", "Zzz... I win that one.", "Snooore!", "Boredom wins!"]

var phase := "inter"
var pt := 0.0
var lives := 4
var score := 0
var speed := 1.0
var level := 1
var since_boss := 0
var pool: Array = []
var micro: Node2D = null
var last := 0   # 1 win, -1 lose, 0 start
var blob_line := "I'll make you SO bored!"
var blob_splats: Array = []
var banner := ""
var banner_sub := ""
var paused := false
var hud: Node2D
var new_best := false
var lost_life := -1
var pause_btn: Dictionary
var b_resume: Dictionary
var b_quit: Dictionary
var b_again: Dictionary
var b_menu: Dictionary
var is_boss := false
var tick_last := -1


func setup() -> void:
	hud = Node2D.new()
	hud.z_index = 20
	add_child(hud)
	hud.draw.connect(_draw_hud)
	canvas = hud
	pause_btn = add_button("", Color("ffffff"), toggle_pause, 40, "pause")
	pause_btn.round = true
	b_resume = add_button("RESUME", G.LIME, toggle_pause, 52)
	b_quit = add_button("QUIT", G.RED, func(): G.main.go("title"), 52)
	b_again = add_button("PLAY AGAIN", G.LIME, func(): G.main.go("blast", arg), 50)
	b_menu = add_button("MENU", G.CYAN, func(): G.main.go("title"), 50)
	for b in [b_resume, b_quit, b_again, b_menu]:
		b.visible = false
	if arg is Dictionary and arg.has("speed"):
		speed = arg.speed
	G.play_music("blast", speed)
	bg(Color("6b3fd4"), Color("7d52e0"), 3, 80, 0.6)
	pt = -0.6


func layout() -> void:
	pause_btn.rect = Rect2(Vector2(W - 120 * U, 24 * U), Vector2(96, 96) * U)
	var bw := 360 * U
	var bh := 110 * U
	b_resume.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H * 0.5 - 40 * U, bw, bh)
	b_quit.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H * 0.5 + 110 * U, bw, bh)
	if portrait:
		b_again.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H - 330 * U, bw, bh)
		b_menu.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H - 190 * U, bw, bh)
	else:
		b_again.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw - 20 * U, H - 170 * U, bw, bh)
		b_menu.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 + 20 * U, H - 170 * U, bw, bh)
	if micro:
		micro.queue_free()
		micro = null
		if phase in ["prompt", "play", "result"]:
			phase = "inter"
			pt = 0.0


func toggle_pause() -> void:
	if phase == "over":
		return
	paused = not paused
	b_resume.visible = paused
	b_quit.visible = paused
	G.set_music_pitch(0.01 if paused else speed)
	if paused:
		G.music_player.stream_paused = true
	else:
		G.music_player.stream_paused = false


func next_id() -> String:
	if arg is Dictionary and arg.has("only") and MICROS.has(arg.only):
		return arg.only
	if pool.is_empty():
		pool = MICROS.keys()
		pool.shuffle()
	return pool.pop_back()


func inter_len() -> float:
	return (2.2 if last == 0 else 1.5) / speed


func update(dt: float) -> void:
	if paused:
		return
	pt += dt
	match phase:
		"inter":
			if pt >= inter_len():
				if since_boss >= BOSS_EVERY or (arg is Dictionary and arg.get("only", "") == "boss"):
					show_banner("BOSS TIME!", "Tickle the Boredom Blob!", "boss")
				elif score > 0 and score % 5 == 0 and last == 1 and speed < 1.95 and banner != "SPEED UP!x%d" % score:
					banner_sub = "x%d" % score
					show_banner("SPEED UP!", "", "speedup")
					speed = minf(2.0, speed + 0.12)
					G.set_music_pitch(speed)
				else:
					start_micro(false)
		"banner":
			if pt >= 1.5:
				if banner == "BOSS TIME!":
					start_micro(true)
				else:
					banner = "SPEED UP!x%d" % score
					start_micro(false)
		"prompt":
			if pt >= 0.95 / sqrt(speed):
				phase = "play"
				pt = 0.0
		"play":
			micro.step(dt * speed)
			var left: float = micro.dur - micro.t
			var sec := int(ceil(left))
			if sec <= 3 and sec != tick_last and micro.result == 0:
				tick_last = sec
				G.play("tick" if sec % 2 == 1 else "tock", 1.0, -4.0)
			if micro.result != 0:
				phase = "result"
				pt = 0.0
			elif micro.t >= micro.dur:
				if micro.survive:
					micro.win()
				else:
					micro.lose("TOO SLOW!")
				phase = "result"
				pt = 0.0
		"result":
			micro.step(dt * speed)
			if pt >= (1.3 if is_boss else 0.7):
				finish(micro.result)
		"over":
			pass


func show_banner(s: String, sub: String, snd: String) -> void:
	banner = s
	banner_sub = sub
	phase = "banner"
	pt = 0.0
	G.play(snd)
	if s == "BOSS TIME!":
		bg(Color("2a1250"), Color("3d1d70"), 3, 80, 1.5)
	else:
		bg(Color("ff8a3d"), Color("ffd23f"), 3, 80, 2.5)


func start_micro(boss: bool) -> void:
	is_boss = boss
	var scr: GDScript = BOSS if boss else MICROS[next_id()]
	micro = scr.new()
	add_child(micro)
	move_child(micro, 0)
	micro.init(W, H, level)
	bg(micro.c1, micro.c2, micro.pat, 80 * U, 1.0)
	phase = "prompt"
	pt = 0.0
	tick_last = -1
	G.play("whoosh", 1.2, -6.0)


func finish(res: int) -> void:
	micro.queue_free()
	micro = null
	last = res
	lost_life = -1
	if res > 0:
		score += 1
		G.data.won += 1
		since_boss += 1
		if is_boss:
			since_boss = 0
			level = mini(3, level + 1)
			G.data.boss_wins += 1
			blob_line = "I'LL BE BACK... BIGGER!"
			blob_splats.clear()
			G.play("fanfare")
			fx.confetti(Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.6), 80, 1100 * U)
		else:
			blob_line = WIN_LINES[randi() % WIN_LINES.size()]
			G.play("win")
			blob_splats.append({a = randf() * TAU, d = randf() * 0.7, s = randf_range(0.14, 0.26), col = G.RAINBOW[randi() % 6], seed = randf() * 9})
	else:
		lives -= 1
		lost_life = lives
		if is_boss:
			since_boss = 0
		blob_line = LOSE_LINES[randi() % LOSE_LINES.size()]
		G.play("lose")
		G.play("yawn", 1.0, -6.0)
	is_boss = false
	bg(Color("6b3fd4"), Color("7d52e0"), 3, 80, 0.6 * speed)
	if lives <= 0:
		game_over()
		return
	phase = "inter"
	pt = 0.0


func game_over() -> void:
	phase = "over"
	pt = 0.0
	pause_btn.visible = false
	G.data.rounds += 1
	new_best = score > int(G.data.best)
	if new_best:
		G.data.best = score
	G.save_game()
	G.stop_music()
	bg(Color("4b4f66"), Color("575c75"), 2, 90, 0.3)
	b_again.visible = true
	b_menu.visible = true
	if new_best and score > 0:
		G.play("fanfare")
		fx.rain(W, 120)
	else:
		G.play("yawn")


func down(p: Vector2, i: int) -> void:
	if phase == "play" and not paused and micro:
		micro.touching[i] = true
		micro.down(p, i)


func drag(p: Vector2, i: int, rel: Vector2) -> void:
	if phase in ["play", "result"] and not paused and micro:
		micro.drag(p, i, rel)


func up(p: Vector2, i: int) -> void:
	if micro and not paused:
		micro.touching.erase(i)
		if phase in ["play", "result"]:
			micro.up(p, i)


func _process(dt: float) -> void:
	super(dt)
	hud.queue_redraw()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ drawing
func paint() -> void:
	if phase in ["inter", "over", "banner"]:
		draw_stage()


func draw_stage() -> void:
	var t := T
	var blob_r := (150.0 + (4 - lives) * 22.0) * U
	var bc := Vector2(W * 0.5, H - blob_r * 0.9 - 40 * U)
	if phase == "over":
		blob_r = 230 * U
		bc = Vector2(W * 0.5, H * (0.62 if portrait else 0.58))
	var mood := 0
	if phase == "inter" and last == 1:
		mood = 2 if pt < 0.8 else 4
	elif phase == "inter" and last == -1:
		mood = 1
	elif phase == "over":
		mood = 1 if fmod(pt, 4.0) < 1.6 else 0
	var bounce := 1.0 + sin(pt * 14.0) * 0.06 * maxf(0.0, 1.0 - pt * 2.0)
	G.boredom_blob(self, bc, blob_r, t, mood, blob_splats, bounce)
	if phase == "over":
		G.speech(self, bc + Vector2(blob_r * 0.4, -blob_r * 0.85), bc + Vector2(blob_r * 1.1 if not portrait else 0.0, -blob_r * 1.5), "Zzz... I WIN. Come back when you're bored!", int(32 * U), 360 * U)
		return
	# speech
	if phase == "inter":
		var sc := bc + Vector2(blob_r * 1.25 if not portrait else blob_r * 0.4, -blob_r * 1.05)
		G.speech(self, bc + Vector2(blob_r * 0.5, -blob_r * 0.8), sc, blob_line, int(32 * U), 330 * U)
	# score + lives
	var top := 150.0 * U
	G.txt(self, Vector2(W * 0.5, top), str(score), int(150 * U), G.YELLOW, int(22 * U))
	G.txt(self, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 100 * U), "GAMES BEATEN" if score != 1 else "GAME BEATEN", int(30 * U), Color.WHITE, int(7 * U))
	var gap := 130.0 * U
	for k in 4:
		var p := Vector2(W * 0.5 + (k - 1.5) * gap, top + 200 * U)
		var alive := k < lives
		var just := k == lost_life and phase == "inter"
		var mood2 := 0 if alive else 2
		if just and pt < 0.6:
			p += Vector2(randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1)) * 10 * U
			mood2 = 1
		var bob := sin(t * 6.0 + k) * 6 * U if alive else 0.0
		G.buddy(self, p + Vector2(0, bob), 46 * U, BUDDY_COLS[k], t + k, mood2)
	if is_boss_next():
		G.txt(self, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 290 * U), "BOSS IN %d!" % (BOSS_EVERY - since_boss), int(34 * U), G.PINK, int(8 * U))


func is_boss_next() -> bool:
	return BOSS_EVERY - since_boss <= 3 and BOSS_EVERY - since_boss > 0


func _draw_hud() -> void:
	var ci := hud
	if phase == "banner":
		var k := minf(1.0, pt * 4.0)
		var sc := 1.0 + (1.0 - k) * 2.0
		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(0, H * 0.5 - 130 * U, W, 260 * U), Color(G.NAVY, 0.75))
		G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5 - 20 * U), banner, int(120 * U * sc), G.YELLOW if banner != "BOSS TIME!" else G.PINK, int(20 * U))
		if banner_sub != "" and banner == "BOSS TIME!":
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5 + 80 * U), banner_sub, int(40 * U), Color.WHITE, int(8 * U))
	if micro and phase in ["prompt", "play", "result"]:
		if phase == "prompt":
			var k := minf(1.0, pt * 5.0)
			var sc := 1.0 + (1.0 - k) * 1.6 + sin(minf(pt * 5.0, 1.0) * PI) * 0.15
			ci.draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, H), Color(G.NAVY, 0.35))
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.45), micro.word, int(150 * U * sc), Color.WHITE, int(24 * U))
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.45 + 120 * U), micro.hint, int(38 * U), G.YELLOW, int(9 * U), G.font_bold)
		else:
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, 70 * U), micro.word, int(70 * U), Color.WHITE, int(14 * U))
			draw_fuse(ci)
		if phase == "result":
			var ok: bool = micro.result > 0
			var k2 := minf(1.0, pt * 6.0)
			var s := "YES!" if ok else "OOPS!"
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5), s, int(170 * U * (0.6 + 0.4 * k2)), G.LIME if ok else Color("ff5d6c"), int(24 * U))
	if phase == "over":
		var top := 120.0 * U
		G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, top), "GAME OVER", int(110 * U), G.PINK, int(20 * U))
		G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 120 * U), "You beat %d game%s!" % [score, "" if score == 1 else "s"], int(54 * U), Color.WHITE, int(12 * U))
		if new_best and score > 0:
			var s2 := 1.0 + sin(T * 8.0) * 0.06
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 200 * U), "NEW RECORD!", int(60 * U * s2), G.YELLOW, int(14 * U))
		else:
			G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 200 * U), "Best: %d" % int(G.data.best), int(46 * U), G.YELLOW, int(10 * U))
	if paused:
		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, H), Color(G.NAVY, 0.7))
		G.txt(ci, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5 - 170 * U), "PAUSED", int(100 * U), G.YELLOW, int(18 * U))
	for b in buttons:
		if b.visible:
			draw_button(b)
	fx.draw(ci)


func _draw() -> void:
	paint()


func draw_fuse(ci: CanvasItem) -> void:
	var f := clampf(1.0 - micro.t / micro.dur, 0.0, 1.0)
	var y := H - 50 * U
	var x0 := 120.0 * U
	var x1 := W - 60 * U
	var xe := lerpf(x0, x1, f)
	ci.draw_line(Vector2(x0, y), Vector2(x1, y), Color(G.NAVY, 0.4), 18 * U, true)
	if f > 0.0:
		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
		var n := 30
		for k in n + 1:
			var x := lerpf(x0, xe, k / float(n))
			pts.append(Vector2(x, y + sin(x * 0.05) * 5 * U))
		ci.draw_polyline(pts, G.NAVY, 20 * U, true)
		ci.draw_polyline(pts, Color("e8c48a"), 12 * U, true)
		var sp := Vector2(xe, y)
		for k in 6:
			var a := randf() * TAU
			ci.draw_line(sp, sp + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * randf_range(14, 34) * U, [G.YELLOW, G.ORANGE, Color.WHITE][k % 3], 4 * U, true)
		ci.draw_circle(sp, 12 * U, Color.WHITE, true, -1.0, true)
	# bomb
	var bc := Vector2(70 * U, y - 6 * U)
	G.circ(ci, bc, 46 * U, Color("3a2d55"), 5 * U)
	G.shine(ci, bc, 46 * U, 0.4)
	var left: float = micro.dur - micro.t
	if left < 3.0 and micro.result == 0:
		G.txt(ci, bc, str(int(ceil(left))), int(52 * U), G.YELLOW, int(8 * U))

var b_back: Dictionary

var sparks: Array = []

var finale := 0.0
var finale_next := 0.0
var kind_i := 0
var flash := 0.0
const KINDS := ["peony", "ring", "heart", "willow", "star", "double"]


func setup() -> void:
	b_back = add_back(func(): G.main.go("fidget"))
	b_finale = add_button("FINALE!", G.PINK, start_finale, 36)
	bg(Color("0b0820"), Color("2a1650"), 4)

	glow = Node2D.new()
	var m := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
	m.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	glow.material = m
	add_child(glow)
	glow.draw.connect(_draw_glow)


func layout() -> void:
	place_back(b_back)
	b_finale.rect = Rect2(W - 250 * U, 30 * U, 220 * U, 84 * U)


func start_finale() -> void:
	finale = 3.5
	finale_next = 0.0


func launch(target: Vector2) -> void:
	var start := Vector2(clampf(target.x + randf_range(-80, 80) * U, 60 * U, W - 60 * U), H + 10 * U)
	rockets.append({p = start, s = start, tgt = target, t = 0.0, dur = randf_range(0.7, 0.95), col = G.RAINBOW[randi() % 6], col2 = G.RAINBOW[randi() % 6],
		kind = KINDS[kind_i % KINDS.size()]})
	kind_i += 1
	G.play("whoosh", randf_range(0.9, 1.15), -6.0)
	G.data.fireworks += 1


func down(p: Vector2, _i: int) -> void:
	launch(Vector2(p.x, minf(p.y, H - 220 * U)))


func explode(r: Dictionary) -> void:
	var p: Vector2 = r.p
	var n := 70
	G.play("boom", randf_range(0.8, 1.2), -2.0)
	flash = 0.35
	match r.kind:
		"peony", "double":
			for k in n:
				var a := randf() * TAU
				var sp := randf_range(0.3, 1.0) * 520 * U
				add_spark(p, Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * sp, r.col if k % 3 else r.col2, randf_range(1.2, 1.8))
			if r.kind == "double":
				for k in 40:
					var a := TAU * k / 40.0
					add_spark(p, Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * 260 * U, Color.WHITE, 1.3)
		"ring":
			for k in 60:
				var a := TAU * k / 60.0
				add_spark(p, Vector2(cos(a), sin(a) * 0.55) * 480 * U, r.col, 1.4)
		"heart":
			for k in 60:
				var tt := TAU * k / 60.0
				var v := Vector2(16.0 * pow(sin(tt), 3), -(13.0 * cos(tt) - 5.0 * cos(2 * tt) - 2.0 * cos(3 * tt) - cos(4 * tt))) * 22 * U
				add_spark(p, v, G.PINK, 1.5)
		"willow":
			for k in 80:
				var a := randf() * TAU
				add_spark(p, Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * randf_range(0.3, 1.0) * 380 * U, Color("ffcf6b"), randf_range(2.2, 3.0), 0.5)
			G.play("sparkle", 0.8, -4.0)
		"star":
			for k in 5:
				var a := -PI / 2 + TAU * k / 5.0
				for s in 14:
					add_spark(p, Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * (120 + s * 30) * U, r.col, 1.3)
			for k in 30:
				var a := randf() * TAU
				add_spark(p, Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * 150 * U, r.col2, 1.0)


func add_spark(p: Vector2, v: Vector2, col: Color, life: float, drag_k := 1.0) -> void:
	sparks.append({p = p, v = v, col = col, life = life, max = life, dk = drag_k, tw = randf() * 10.0})


func update(dt: float) -> void:
	flash = maxf(0.0, flash - dt)
	if finale > 0.0:
		finale -= dt
		finale_next -= dt
		if finale_next <= 0.0:
			finale_next = 0.18
			launch(Vector2(randf_range(100, W / U - 100) * U, randf_range(160, H / U * 0.55) * U))
	var i := rockets.size() - 1
	while i >= 0:
		var r: Dictionary = rockets[i]
		r.t += dt
		var f: float = r.t / r.dur
		var e := 1.0 - pow(1.0 - f, 2.0)
		var np: Vector2 = r.s.lerp(r.tgt, e) + Vector2(sin(r.t * 30.0) * 3 * U, 0)
		add_spark(np, Vector2(randf_range(-30, 30), randf_range(60, 140)) * U, Color("ffd9a0"), 0.35)
		r.p = np
		if f >= 1.0:
			explode(r)
			rockets.remove_at(i)
		i -= 1
	i = sparks.size() - 1
	while i >= 0:
		var s: Dictionary = sparks[i]
		s.life -= dt
		if s.life <= 0.0:
			sparks.remove_at(i)
		else:
			s.v *= 1.0 - 1.3 * s.dk * dt
			s.v.y += 160 * U * dt
			s.p += s.v * dt
		i -= 1
	glow.queue_redraw()

func paint() -> void:
	if flash > 0.0:
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, H), Color(1, 1, 1, flash * 0.12))
	# skyline
	var base := H - 40 * U
	var x := 0.0
	var k := 0
	while x < W:
		var bw := (60 + (k * 37) % 70) * U
		var bh := (90 + (k * 53) % 170) * U
		draw_rect(Rect2(x, base - bh, bw - 6 * U, bh + 40 * U), Color("140d2a"))
		for wy in range(int(bh / (30 * U)) - 1):
			for wx in range(int((bw - 16 * U) / (22 * U))):

	G.txt(self, Vector2(W * 0.5, 70 * U), "TAP THE SKY!", int(56 * U), Color.WHITE, int(10 * U))
	G.txt(self, Vector2(W * 0.5, H - 18 * U), "Launched: %d" % int(G.data.fireworks), int(24 * U), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8), 0, G.font_bold)


func _draw_glow() -> void:
	for r in rockets:
		glow.draw_circle(r.p, 7 * U, Color(1, 0.9, 0.7), true, -1.0, true)
	for s in sparks:

		var t = load("res://scripts/selftest.gd").new()
		add_child(t)
		return
	var start := "title"
	var start_arg = null
	for a in args:
		if a.begins_with("--screen="):
			start = a.substr(9)
	if OS.has_feature("web"):
		var h = JavaScriptBridge.eval("location.hash", true)
		if h is String and h.begins_with("#s-"):
			start = h.substr(3)
		elif h is String and h.begins_with("#m-"):
			start = "blast"
			start_arg = {"only": h.substr(3)}

	if "--poke" in args:
		_poke()


func _poke() -> void:
	## random touches for headless smoke tests
	var vs := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var p := Vector2(randf() * vs.x, randf() * vs.y)
	for k in 400:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		var e
		match k % 8:
			0:
				p = Vector2(randf_range(0.15, 0.85) * vs.x, randf_range(0.2, 0.85) * vs.y)
				e = InputEventScreenTouch.new()
				e.pressed = true

				e = InputEventScreenDrag.new()
				var d := Vector2(randf_range(-60, 60), randf_range(-60, 60))
				e.relative = d
				p += d
			6:
				e = InputEventScreenTouch.new()
				e.pressed = false
			_:
				continue
		e.index = 0
		e.position = p
		Input.parse_input_event(e)
	print("POKE_DONE")
	get_tree().quit()

	wipe_mat.set_shader_parameter("size", s)

	if flip > 0.0:

	# pointer at the top (angle -PI/2). slice k spans [k*sa, (k+1)*sa] measured from ang.
	var sa := TAU / SLICES.size()
	var rel := wrapf(-PI / 2 - ang, 0, TAU)

		w = maxf(0.0, w - (1.6 + w * 0.32) * dt)

		if s != last_slot:

			G.play("wtick", 1.0 + w * 0.03, -2.0)

"""Synthesize every sound effect and music loop for Anti-Boredom.
SFX -> ~/ab/sfx/*.wav (16-bit mono 44.1 kHz). Music -> ~/ab/music/*.ogg (seamless loops)."""
import os, wave, subprocess
import numpy as np

SR = 44100
OUT = "/home/claude/ab/sfx"
MOUT = "/home/claude/ab/music"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(MOUT, exist_ok=True)
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)


def t_(dur):
    return np.arange(int(dur * SR)) / SR


def write(name, x, peak=0.85):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = x / m * peak
    # 3 ms fade in/out to kill clicks
    f = min(len(x) // 4, int(0.003 * SR))
    if f > 0:
        x[:f] *= np.linspace(0, 1, f)
        x[-f:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, f)
    d = (x * 32767).astype(np.int16)
    with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".wav"), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(d.tobytes())


def noise(n):
    return rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)


def onepole_lp(x, fc):
    a = np.exp(-2 * np.pi * np.asarray(fc) / SR)
    y = np.zeros_like(x); s = 0.0
    if np.ndim(a) == 0:
        for i in range(len(x)):
            s = (1 - a) * x[i] + a * s; y[i] = s
    else:
        for i in range(len(x)):
            s = (1 - a[i]) * x[i] + a[i] * s; y[i] = s
    return y


def hp(x, fc):
    return x - onepole_lp(x, fc)


def bandpass(x, fc, q=4.0):
    """State-variable band-pass; fc may be an array (sweeps)."""
    fc = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(fc, dtype=float), x.shape)
    y = np.zeros_like(x); low = 0.0; band = 0.0
    damp = 1.0 / q
    for i in range(len(x)):
        f = 2 * np.sin(np.pi * min(fc[i], SR / 6) / SR)
        low += f * band
        high = x[i] - low - damp * band
        band += f * high
        y[i] = band
    return y


def sweep_phase(f0, f1, dur, curve="exp"):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    if curve == "exp":
        f = f0 * (f1 / f0) ** np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    else:
        f = np.linspace(f0, f1, n)
    return np.cumsum(f) / SR * 2 * np.pi, f


def expdec(n, tau):
    return np.exp(-np.arange(n) / SR / tau)


def square(ph, duty=0.5):
    return np.where((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0 < duty, 1.0, -1.0)


def saw(ph):
    return 2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) - 1


def tri(ph):
    return 2 * np.abs(saw(ph)) - 1


def note(n):  # midi -> Hz
    return 440.0 * 2 ** ((n - 69) / 12)


def pad(x, dur):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    out = np.zeros(max(n, len(x))); out[:len(x)] = x
    return out


def mix_at(buf, x, t0, gain=1.0):
    i = int(t0 * SR)
    j = min(len(buf), i + len(x))
    if j > i:
        buf[i:j] += x[: j - i] * gain


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- SFX
def balloon_pop(seed_f=1.0):
    n = int(0.22 * SR)
    nz = hp(noise(n), 900 * seed_f) * expdec(n, 0.018)
    ph, _ = sweep_phase(220 * seed_f, 55, 0.22)
    thump = np.sin(ph) * expdec(n, 0.05) * 0.8
    return nz + thump


for i, s in enumerate([1.0, 1.25, 0.85]):
    write(f"pop{i+1}", balloon_pop(s))


def wrap_pop(f):
    n = int(0.09 * SR)
    click = hp(noise(n), 2500) * expdec(n, 0.004)
    res = np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t_(0.09)) * expdec(n, 0.012) * 0.6
    body = bandpass(noise(n), 900, 3) * expdec(n, 0.01) * 1.5
    return click + res + body


for i, f in enumerate([2600, 3100, 2200]):
    write(f"wrap{i+1}", wrap_pop(f))


def soft_pop(f):
    n = int(0.14 * SR)
    ph, _ = sweep_phase(f, f * 0.55, 0.14)
    body = np.sin(ph) * expdec(n, 0.03)
    air = onepole_lp(noise(n), 1500) * expdec(n, 0.012) * 2
    return body + air


write("popit1", soft_pop(420))
write("popit2", soft_pop(330))

ph, _ = sweep_phase(950, 260, 0.14)
write("boop", (np.sin(ph) + 0.25 * square(ph)) * expdec(len(ph), 0.07))

n = int(0.05 * SR)
write("tap", hp(noise(n), 3000) * expdec(n, 0.002) + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1500 * t_(0.05)) * expdec(n, 0.01) * 0.5, 0.6)

n = int(0.25 * SR)
fc = np.linspace(700, 4500, n)
env = np.sin(np.linspace(0, np.pi, n)) ** 2
write("swish", bandpass(noise(n), fc, 2.5) * env, 0.7)

n = int(0.3 * SR)
ph, _ = sweep_phase(240, 60, 0.3)
write("splat", onepole_lp(noise(n), 900) * expdec(n, 0.06) * 3 + np.sin(ph) * expdec(n, 0.08))

n = int(0.9 * SR)
tt = t_(0.9)
write("ding", sum(a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1320 * m * tt) * expdec(n, d) for m, a, d in [(1, 1, 0.5), (2.76, 0.4, 0.2), (5.4, 0.2, 0.08)]), 0.7)

# coin
x = np.concatenate([square(2 * np.pi * 988 * t_(0.07)) * 0.5, square(2 * np.pi * 1319 * t_(0.22)) * 0.5 * expdec(int(0.22 * SR), 0.09)])
write("coin", x, 0.5)


def chip(notes, step, wave_fn=square, decay=0.12, duty=0.5, tail=0.3):
    total = len(notes) * step + tail
    buf = np.zeros(int(total * SR))
    for k, nn in enumerate(notes):
        if nn is None:
            continue
        dur = step + (tail if k == len(notes) - 1 else 0.02)
        tt = t_(dur)
        ph = 2 * np.pi * note(nn) * tt
        v = (square(ph, duty) if wave_fn is square else wave_fn(ph)) * expdec(len(tt), decay)
        mix_at(buf, v, k * step)
    return buf


win = chip([72, 76, 79, 84], 0.075, decay=0.1, duty=0.25, tail=0.45)
bass = chip([48, 52, 55, 60], 0.075, wave_fn=tri, decay=0.2, tail=0.45)
sparkle = np.zeros_like(win)
for k in range(6):
    tt = t_(0.12)
    mix_at(sparkle, np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(2500, 4200) * tt) * expdec(len(tt), 0.03) * 0.3, 0.3 + k * 0.05)
write("win", win + bass * 0.8 + sparkle, 0.75)

# sad trombone
buf = np.zeros(int(1.6 * SR))
for k, (nn, d) in enumerate([(67, 0.28), (66, 0.28), (65, 0.28), (64, 0.8)]):
    tt = t_(d)
    f = note(nn - 12) * (1 + (0.025 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 6 * tt) * (tt / d) if k == 3 else 0))
    ph = np.cumsum(f) / SR * 2 * np.pi
    s = saw(ph)
    wah = 400 + 1400 * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(tt / d, 0, 1)) ** 0.7
    v = onepole_lp(s, wah) * np.minimum(1, tt / 0.03) * (expdec(len(tt), 0.5) if k == 3 else 1)
    mix_at(buf, v, k * 0.28)
write("lose", buf, 0.7)

up = chip([60, 64, 67, 72, 76, 79, 84, 88], 0.05, decay=0.08, duty=0.25, tail=0.2)
ph, _ = sweep_phase(300, 1500, 0.45)
write("speedup", up + pad(np.sin(ph) * 0.3 * np.linspace(1, 0, len(ph)), len(up) / SR), 0.7)

# boss brass stabs
buf = np.zeros(int(1.4 * SR))
for k, base in enumerate([40, 40, 43]):
    tt = t_(0.35)
    v = sum(saw(2 * np.pi * note(base + iv) * tt * (1 + 0.003 * j)) for j, iv in enumerate([0, 7, 12, 15]))
    v = onepole_lp(v, 1800 * expdec(len(tt), 0.15) + 200) * expdec(len(tt), 0.2)
    mix_at(buf, v, k * 0.3)
kick_t = t_(0.3); kp, _ = sweep_phase(150, 40, 0.3)
for k in range(3):
    mix_at(buf, np.sin(kp) * expdec(len(kp), 0.1) * 2.5, k * 0.3)
write("boss", buf, 0.8)

levelup = chip([67, 71, 74, 79, 74, 79, 83, 86], 0.06, decay=0.1, duty=0.3, tail=0.5)
write("levelup", levelup, 0.7)

fan = chip([72, 72, 72, 72, None, 68, None, 70, None, 72, None, 70, 72], 0.09, decay=0.15, duty=0.3, tail=0.6)
fanb = chip([48, None, None, None, None, 44, None, 46, None, 48, None, None, 48], 0.09, wave_fn=tri, decay=0.3, tail=0.6)
write("fanfare", fan + fanb, 0.75)

# clock tick / tock
for nm, f in [("tick", 2100), ("tock", 1500)]:
    n = int(0.06 * SR)
    write(nm, np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t_(0.06)) * expdec(n, 0.012) + hp(noise(n), 4000) * expdec(n, 0.003) * 0.6, 0.6)

n = int(0.03 * SR)
write("click", hp(noise(n), 2000) * expdec(n, 0.003) + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3200 * t_(0.03)) * expdec(n, 0.004), 0.6)


def squish(f0, f1, dur, wob):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    tt = t_(dur)
    am = 0.55 + 0.45 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * wob * tt)
    fc = f0 * (f1 / f0) ** np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    v = bandpass(onepole_lp(noise(n), 1400), fc, 6) * am
    env = np.sin(np.linspace(0, np.pi, n)) ** 0.7
    return v * env


write("squish1", squish(420, 160, 0.28, 18))
write("squish2", squish(260, 520, 0.24, 25))
write("squish3", squish(600, 220, 0.35, 12))

n = int(0.7 * SR)
fc = 350 * (3000 / 350) ** np.linspace(0, 1, n)
env = np.minimum(1, np.linspace(0, 2.2, n)) * np.linspace(1, 0.2, n)
write("whoosh", bandpass(noise(n), fc, 3) * env, 0.6)

n = int(1.6 * SR)
boom = onepole_lp(noise(n), 260) * expdec(n, 0.35) * 4 + np.sin(sweep_phase(90, 35, 1.6)[0]) * expdec(n, 0.25) * 1.2

    v *= np.sin(np.linspace(0, np.pi, len(tt))) ** 0.6
    mix_at(buf, v, k * 0.12)
write("giggle", buf, 0.75)

# yawn

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- MUSIC
def drum_kick(g=1.0):
    d = 0.25
    n = int(d * SR)
    return np.sin(sweep_phase(160, 45, d)[0]) * expdec(n, 0.08) * g


def drum_snare(g=1.0):
    d = 0.2
    n = int(d * SR)
    return (hp(noise(n), 1500) * expdec(n, 0.06) + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 190 * t_(d)) * expdec(n, 0.04) * 0.6) * g


def drum_hat(g=1.0, open_=False):
    d = 0.15 if open_ else 0.05
    n = int(d * SR)
    return hp(noise(n), 7000) * expdec(n, 0.05 if open_ else 0.012) * g


def render_loop(bars, bpm, build, name, gain=0.8):
    beat = 60.0 / bpm
    L = bars * 4 * beat
    buf = np.zeros(int((L + 2.0) * SR))
    build(buf, beat)
    n = int(L * SR)
    out = buf[:n].copy()
    out[: len(buf) - n] += buf[n:]  # wrap tail -> seamless
    out = out / np.max(np.abs(out)) * gain
    wav = os.path.join(MOUT, name + ".wav")
    with wave.open(wav, "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes((out * 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes())
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", wav, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "4", os.path.join(MOUT, name + ".ogg")], check=True)
    os.remove(wav)
    print("music", name, round(L, 2), "s")


def tone(freq, dur, kind="square", duty=0.5, decay=0.25, att=0.005):
    tt = t_(dur)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * freq * tt
    if kind == "square":
        v = square(ph, duty)
    elif kind == "tri":
        v = tri(ph)
    elif kind == "saw":
        v = saw(ph)
    elif kind == "ep":  # soft electric piano
        v = np.sin(ph + 1.2 * np.sin(2 * ph) * np.exp(-tt / 0.3)) * 0.8 + 0.2 * np.sin(2 * ph)
    else:
        v = np.sin(ph)
    return v * np.minimum(1, tt / att) * np.exp(-tt / decay)


def build_blast(buf, beat):
    # 8 bars at 132 bpm, key C. chords: C G Am F | C G F G
    prog = [(48, [0, 4, 7]), (43, [0, 4, 7]), (45, [0, 3, 7]), (41, [0, 4, 7]), (48, [0, 4, 7]), (43, [0, 4, 7]), (41, [0, 4, 7]), (43, [0, 4, 7])]
    mel = [72, None, 76, 79, 77, 76, 74, None, 74, None, 79, 77, 76, 74, 72, None,
           69, None, 72, 76, 77, 76, 72, None, 77, None, 76, 74, 72, 74, 76, None,
           72, None, 76, 79, 81, 79, 76, None, 74, None, 79, 77, 76, 74, 79, None,
           77, 76, 74, 72, 74, 76, 77, 79, 79, None, 83, None, 84, None, None, None]
    e = beat / 2
    for b, (root, ch) in enumerate(prog):
        t0 = b * 4 * beat
        for k in range(8):  # bass eighths octave bounce
            f = note(root - 12 + (12 if k % 2 else 0))
            mix_at(buf, tone(f, e * 0.9, "tri", decay=0.18), t0 + k * e, 0.55)
        for k in range(8):  # arp sixteenths-ish (eighths)
            nn = root + 12 + ch[k % 3] + (12 if k >= 4 else 0)
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(nn), e * 0.8, "square", 0.125, decay=0.07), t0 + k * e, 0.12)
        for k in range(4):
            mix_at(buf, drum_kick(1.0), t0 + k * beat, 0.9 if k % 2 == 0 else 0.6)
            if k % 2 == 1:
                mix_at(buf, drum_snare(), t0 + k * beat, 0.45)
            mix_at(buf, drum_hat(), t0 + k * beat + e, 0.25)
            mix_at(buf, drum_hat(), t0 + k * beat, 0.12)
    for k, nn in enumerate(mel):
        if nn is not None:
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(nn), e * 1.6, "square", 0.25, decay=0.16), k * e, 0.22)


def build_menu(buf, beat):
    prog = [(48, [0, 4, 7, 11]), (45, [0, 3, 7, 10]), (41, [0, 4, 7, 11]), (43, [0, 4, 7, 10])] * 2
    mel = [76, None, None, 74, 72, None, 74, None, 76, None, 79, None, None, None, None, None,
           72, None, None, 71, 69, None, 71, None, 72, None, 76, None, None, None, None, None,
           69, None, 72, None, 76, None, 77, None, 76, None, 74, None, 72, None, None, None,
           74, None, 76, None, 74, None, 71, None, 67, None, None, None, None, None, None, None]
    e = beat / 2
    for b, (root, ch) in enumerate(prog):
        t0 = b * 4 * beat
        mix_at(buf, tone(note(root - 12), beat * 1.5, "tri", decay=0.6), t0, 0.6)
        mix_at(buf, tone(note(root - 12 + 7), beat * 1.0, "tri", decay=0.4), t0 + 2 * beat, 0.45)
        mix_at(buf, tone(note(root - 12), beat * 0.9, "tri", decay=0.3), t0 + 3 * beat, 0.4)
        for k in range(8):
            nn = root + 12 + ch[[0, 2, 1, 3, 2, 1, 3, 2][k]]
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(nn), e, "ep", decay=0.35), t0 + k * e, 0.18)
        for k in range(4):
            mix_at(buf, drum_kick(0.8), t0 + k * beat, 0.5 if k in (0, 2) else 0.0)
            if k in (1, 3):
                mix_at(buf, drum_snare(0.6), t0 + k * beat, 0.25)
            mix_at(buf, drum_hat(), t0 + k * beat + e, 0.12)
    for k, nn in enumerate(mel):
        if nn is not None:
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(nn), e * 2.4, "square", 0.5, decay=0.3), k * e, 0.13)
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(nn + 12), e * 2.0, "sine", decay=0.3), k * e, 0.08)


def build_chill(buf, beat):
    prog = [(50, [0, 3, 7, 10, 14]), (43, [0, 4, 7, 10, 14]), (48, [0, 4, 7, 11, 14]), (45, [0, 3, 7, 10, 14])] * 2
    e = beat / 2
    for b, (root, ch) in enumerate(prog):
        t0 = b * 4 * beat
        for j, iv in enumerate(ch):
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(root + 12 + iv), beat * 3.5, "ep", decay=1.2, att=0.02), t0 + j * 0.03, 0.12)
            mix_at(buf, tone(note(root + 12 + iv), beat * 1.5, "ep", decay=0.6, att=0.02), t0 + 2.5 * beat + j * 0.02, 0.07)
        mix_at(buf, tone(note(root - 12), beat * 2.5, "sine", decay=1.0, att=0.01), t0, 0.5)
        mix_at(buf, tone(note(root - 12), beat * 1.0, "sine", decay=0.5, att=0.01), t0 + 2.75 * beat, 0.35)
        for k in range(4):
            if k in (0, 2):
                mix_at(buf, drum_kick(0.7), t0 + k * beat + (0.0 if k == 0 else e * 0.5), 0.5)
            if k in (1, 3):
                mix_at(buf, drum_snare(0.5), t0 + k * beat, 0.18)
            mix_at(buf, drum_hat(), t0 + k * beat + e * 1.1, 0.1)
            mix_at(buf, drum_hat(), t0 + k * beat, 0.06)
    # vinyl crackle
    n = len(buf)
    crk = (rng.uniform(0, 1, n) > 0.9993) * rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    buf += onepole_lp(crk, 3000) * 0.5 + onepole_lp(noise(n), 800) * 0.01

"""Load the exported web build in headless Chromium, take screenshots, report console errors.
usage: python3 webtest.py <outdir> [script]  script = semicolon list of actions:
  wait:ms | tap:x,y (fractions of viewport) | shot:name | size:w,h | hold:x,y,ms | swipe:x1,y1,x2,y2
"""
import sys, os, subprocess, time, socket
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

out = sys.argv[1]
script = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "wait:9000;shot:title"
W, H = 1024, 768
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)


def free_port():
    s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); p = s.getsockname()[1]; s.close(); return p


port = free_port()
srv = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "http.server", str(port), "--bind", "127.0.0.1"], cwd="/home/claude/ab/build",
                       stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(0.8)
errors = []
try:
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.launch(args=["--no-proxy-server", "--use-angle=swiftshader", "--enable-unsafe-swiftshader", "--ignore-gpu-blocklist",
                                    "--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required"])
        ctx = b.new_context(viewport={"width": W, "height": H}, device_scale_factor=1, has_touch=False)
        pg = ctx.new_page()
        pg.on("console", lambda m: errors.append(f"{m.type}: {m.text}") if m.type in ("error", "warning") or "ERROR" in m.text else None)
        pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(f"pageerror: {e}"))
        pg.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html")
        for act in script.split(";"):
            act = act.strip()
            if not act:
                continue
            k, _, v = act.partition(":")
            if k == "wait":
                pg.wait_for_timeout(int(v))
            elif k == "tap":
                x, y = [float(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                vw = pg.viewport_size
                pg.mouse.click(x * vw["width"], y * vw["height"])
            elif k == "hold":
                x, y, ms = [float(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                vw = pg.viewport_size
                pg.mouse.move(x * vw["width"], y * vw["height"]); pg.mouse.down(); pg.wait_for_timeout(int(ms)); pg.mouse.up()
            elif k == "swipe":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = [float(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                vw = pg.viewport_size
                pg.mouse.move(x1 * vw["width"], y1 * vw["height"]); pg.mouse.down()
                for s in range(1, 11):
                    f = s / 10
                    pg.mouse.move((x1 + (x2 - x1) * f) * vw["width"], (y1 + (y2 - y1) * f) * vw["height"])
                    pg.wait_for_timeout(16)
                pg.mouse.up()
            elif k == "shot":
                pg.screenshot(path=os.path.join(out, v + ".png"))
            elif k == "goto":
                pg.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html" + v)
                pg.reload()
            elif k == "size":
                w, h = [int(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                pg.set_viewport_size({"width": w, "height": h})
        b.close()
finally:
    srv.terminate()
print("console issues:", len(errors))
for e in errors[:40]:
    print(" ", e[:300])
